name: Braintrust
summary: Braintrust provides evaluation and observability tools for production AI systems. It raised an $80 million Series B in February 2026 at an $800 million post-money valuation, according to the company and Axios Pro.
overview: Braintrust provides tools for evaluating, testing and observing AI applications in production. It addresses the operational problem of measuring whether models and AI features perform reliably after they leave experimentation.

facts.label: Reported valuation
facts.note: Reported valuation for the Series B financing.

bull_case: As AI applications move into production, evaluation and observability can become core infrastructure rather than an optional developer tool. Braintrust can benefit if it establishes a durable workflow and data layer inside engineering teams.
bear_case: AI observability is a fast-moving, competitive category where platform vendors and open-source tools can compress differentiation. An $800 million valuation assumes significant category growth and sustained product adoption.
directory_notes: $80M Series B at $800M post-money in February 2026.

intelligence.description: An AI-infrastructure company providing evaluation and observability tools for production AI.
company: Braintrust helps teams evaluate, test and observe AI applications in production. Its product is aimed at the reliability layer of enterprise AI, where teams need to measure model behaviour, diagnose failures and improve systems over time.

In February 2026, Braintrust announced an $80 million Series B led by ICONIQ. Axios Pro reported that the round valued the company at $800 million post-money, while the company described the financing as support for becoming an observability layer for production AI.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Production AI requires testing and measurement infrastructure that traditional software-monitoring tools were not built to provide. Braintrust is a direct bet on that emerging software layer, where enterprise standardisation could create durable platforms.

changed.text: Announced $80M Series B led by ICONIQ to expand production-AI evaluation and observability.

takeaways: Braintrust is an AI observability and evaluation company, not a talent marketplace.
The $800M post-money valuation was reported alongside its $80M Series B.
Workflow adoption and competitive differentiation will determine whether the category becomes durable infrastructure.
